ref.description: Reference video: a .y4m file, or raw planar .yuv together with the width, height, pixel format and bit depth. (CLI: --reference)

dis.description: Distorted video, in the same form as the reference. (CLI: --distorted)

width.description: Width of raw .yuv input in pixels. (CLI: --width)

height.description: Height of raw .yuv input in pixels. (CLI: --height)

bitdepth.description: Bits per sample of raw .yuv input. (CLI: --bitdepth)

model.description: Model, colon-delimited: version= a built-in model, path= a model file, name= the name in the report, disable_clip, enable_transform, <feature>.<option>=<value> overloads. Several models score in one pass (repeat the option; the filter separates them with |). (CLI: --model) Default: the library default (VMAF_DEFAULT_MODEL_VERSION).

disable_clip.description: Do not clip the model score to [0, 100] (the model's disable_clip).

enable_transform.description: Apply the model's score transform (the model's enable_transform).

backend.description: Backend: auto uses the available ones; any other value runs that backend alone and fails when it is not available. (CLI: --backend)

feature.description: Additional feature extractor, name[=key=value:...] (for example psnr or cambi=full_ref=true); several may be given (the filter separates them with |). Mutually exclusive with the CTC presets. (CLI: --feature)

aom_ctc.description: AOM common test conditions preset: a fixed model and feature set. (CLI: --aom_ctc)

nflx_ctc.description: Netflix common test conditions preset: a fixed model and feature set. (CLI: --nflx_ctc)

tiny_model.description: Tiny ONNX model to load alongside the classic models. (CLI: --tiny-model)

tiny_device.description: ONNX Runtime execution provider of the tiny model. (CLI: --tiny-device)

dnn_ep.description: Alias of the tiny-model device under the ONNX Runtime name (execution provider); both set the same setting. (CLI: --dnn-ep)

tiny_threads.description: Intra-op threads of the CPU execution provider (0: the runtime's default). (CLI: --tiny-threads)

tiny_fp16.description: Request fp16 input and output where the execution provider supports it. (CLI: --tiny-fp16)

tiny_model_verify.description: Require a Sigstore bundle verification of the tiny model (cosign verify-blob) before it loads; a missing bundle, a missing cosign or a failed verification refuses the model. (CLI: --tiny-model-verify)

tiny_codec.description: Encoder of the distorted clip, required by codec-aware tiny models (fr_regressor_v2/v3), which refuse to score without it. Must be in the model sidecar's encoder_vocab; the ffprobe names h264, hevc, av1, vp9 and vvc are accepted. (CLI: --tiny-codec)

tiny_preset.description: Encoder preset (medium, slow, p4, 5, ...), read as the encoder defines it. Unset: ordinal 5 (medium). A model trained with one preset (fr_regressor_v3) ignores it and warns. (CLI: --tiny-preset)

tiny_crf.description: CRF or QP used for the encode, normalised as the model sidecar declares. Required with the codec and preset. (CLI: --tiny-crf)

tiny_resize.description: Resize filter for NCHW tiny models whose input size differs from the frame; disabled refuses the mismatch (-ERANGE). The three filters give scores about 2% apart: record the filter with the model. (CLI: --tiny-resize)

no_reference.description: No-reference mode; needs a no-reference tiny model. The reference becomes a formality: only the distorted picture is scored. (CLI: --no-reference)

threads.description: Worker threads of the feature extractors, capped to the hardware threads (0: score in the calling thread). (CLI: --threads)

frame_cnt.description: Score at most this many frames. (CLI: --frame_cnt)

frame_skip_ref.description: Skip this many frames at the start of the reference. (CLI: --frame_skip_ref)

frame_skip_dist.description: Skip this many frames at the start of the distorted video. (CLI: --frame_skip_dist)

no_prediction.description: Extract features only; no model score. (CLI: --no_prediction)

cpumask.description: Bitmask of CPU instruction sets the extractors must not use. (CLI: --cpumask)

gpumask.description: Bitmask of GPU operations the extractors must not use. (CLI: --gpumask)

sycl_device.description: SYCL GPU by index (unset: selected automatically). (CLI: --sycl_device)

hip_device.description: HIP GPU by index (opt-in: HIP is off unless this or --backend hip is given). (CLI: --hip_device)

metal_device.description: Metal GPU by index (opt-in: Metal is off unless this or --backend metal is given). (CLI: --metal_device)

subsample.description: Score every n-th frame (1: every frame). (CLI: --subsample)

precision.description: Score precision: N (1 to 17) writes %.<N>g; max or full write %.17g (round-trip lossless); legacy writes %.6f (Netflix-compatible). The scoring server returns lossless scores unless asked otherwise. (CLI: --precision)

output_fmt.description: Report format; json and xml carry the backend receipt.

csv.description: Write the report as CSV; the same as output_fmt csv.

sub.description: Write per-frame scores as subtitles; the same as output_fmt sub.

view_distance.description: Viewing distance in display heights (ADM adm_norm_view_dist). Unset: the model's value.

display_height.description: Height of the reference display in pixels (ADM adm_ref_display_height). Unset: the model's value.

target_width.description: Width of the target display the distorted video is scaled to (0: no scaling). Reserved: device-targeted scoring lands in RC5; only the default is accepted.

target_height.description: Height of the target display the distorted video is scaled to (0: no scaling). Reserved: device-targeted scoring lands in RC5; only the default is accepted.

target_scaling.description: Scaling filter towards the target display. Reserved: device-targeted scoring lands in RC5; only the default is accepted.
